chunks.head: in a word
chunks.note: in a word = 用一句话概括、总而言之,引出总结。
chunks.ex_en: In a word, the trip was a great success.
chunks.ex_cn: 总之,这趟旅行非常成功。

chunks.head: on purpose
chunks.note: on purpose = 有意为之(反义 by accident 无意)。

literal.note_cn: 此处表'带着…意图',非'在…上'

chunks.ex_en: He broke the cup on purpose, not by accident.
chunks.ex_cn: 他是故意打碎杯子的,不是失手。

chunks.head: a great deal of
chunks.note: a great deal of + 不可数名词,表'大量'。
chunks.ex_en: She spent a great deal of money on books.

chunks.head: look out for
chunks.note: look out for = 留心寻找、当心某物。

literal.note_cn: 此处配 look 表'四处找'

chunks.ex_en: Please look out for a cheap flight to Tokyo.
chunks.ex_cn: 请帮忙留意一张去东京的便宜机票。

chunks.head: give over
chunks.note: give over = 罢手、不再做(此处放弃找石头)。
chunks.ex_en: After many tries, he gave over and went home.
chunks.ex_cn: 试了很多次后,他放弃了,回了家。

chunks.head: in vain
chunks.note: in vain = 白费力气、没有结果。
chunks.ex_en: We searched all day, but in vain.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们找了一整天,却徒劳无功。

chunks.head: fall into the hands of
chunks.note: fall into the hands of = 被某人(常指坏人)掌控。
chunks.ex_en: The letter must not fall into the hands of the enemy.
chunks.ex_cn: 这封信绝不能落入敌人之手。

chunks.head: put a stop to
chunks.note: put a stop to = 使某事停下来。
chunks.ex_en: The teacher put a stop to the noise at once.

chunks.head: go through with
chunks.note: go through with = 尽管困难仍把计划做完。
chunks.ex_en: She was nervous, but she went through with the plan.
chunks.ex_cn: 她很紧张,但还是把计划坚持做到了底。

chunks.head: nothing to do with
chunks.note: have nothing to do with = 和某人/某事毫无关联。
chunks.ex_en: This problem has nothing to do with me.
chunks.ex_cn: 这个问题跟我没有任何关系。

chunks.head: now and then
chunks.note: now and then = 不时地、偶尔(= now and again)。
chunks.ex_en: We still meet now and then for coffee.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们偶尔还会一起喝杯咖啡。

chunks.head: make use of
chunks.note: make use of = 加以利用某物/机会。
chunks.ex_en: You should make use of every chance to speak English.
chunks.ex_cn: 你应该利用每一个说英语的机会。

chunks.head: take notice of
chunks.note: take notice of = 对某人/某事加以留意。
chunks.ex_en: Nobody took notice of the new student.
chunks.ex_cn: 没人注意到那个新来的学生。

chunks.head: the bright side
chunks.note: look on the bright side = 往好处想、看积极的一面。
chunks.ex_en: Try to look on the bright side of things.

chunks.head: in order to
chunks.note: in order to + 动词原形,表目的。

literal.note_cn: in order to 三词一体表'为了'

chunks.ex_en: He works hard in order to help his family.
chunks.ex_cn: 他努力工作,为的是帮助家里。

chunks.head: at a loss
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(at a great loss),故 card-only。at a loss = 犯难、不知怎么办。
chunks.ex_en: She was at a loss for words when she heard the news.
chunks.ex_cn: 听到这个消息,她一时不知说什么好。

chunks.head: lay up
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(laid it up),故 card-only。lay up = 把东西存起来备用。

literal.note_cn: 此处'储存起来',非一般'放/躺'

chunks.ex_en: The squirrel lays up nuts for the winter.
